# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 21 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 21
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. It is good that one who has learned the righteous judgments of the Lord, as many as are written, should walk in them. For whoever does these things will be glorified in the kingdom of God; but whoever chooses the opposite things will perish along with his works.
2. For this reason there is a resurrection; for this reason there will be a retribution. I beseech those who are in positions of honor: if you receive any of my good counsel, keep among you those from whom you may receive help — and do not neglect this.
3. The day is near in which all things will perish together with the evil one. The Lord is near, and his reward with him.
4. Again and again I urge you: be good lawgivers to one another, remain faithful counselors to one another, remove all hypocrisy from among you.
5. And may God, the Lord of the whole world, give you wisdom, understanding, insight, knowledge of his righteous ordinances, and patience.
6. Be instructed of God, seeking out what the Lord requires of you, and performing it — so that you may be found worthy on the day of judgment.
7. But if there is any recollection of what is good, remember me in meditating on these things, so that both my longing and my watching may count toward some good.
8. I ask you to grant me this request: be faithful to one another.
